author: DOC-029 source-review author agent (access)
labObservations: GET /api/v1/auth/methods on the admin, work and entities labs (read-only) returned the legacy-derived policy: legal and business both password=true, magicLink=true, sso=false, requireTwoFactor=false; emailConfigured=true. No settings or records were changed.
limitations: Source inspection only. No walkthrough was run; the independent walkthrough agent must re-run V-C01 to V-C05 against the corrected text.
The Contributor role was removed by DD-023; scenario roles that still name Contributor were not checked as a role here.
Live identity-provider and required two-factor behaviour after single sign-on are source-checked only.

articles.classification: behaviour change (reopens review; fresh walkthrough needed)

corrections.before: A Legal Team Member who uses Administrator sign-in sees 'Password sign-in is disabled while single sign-on is required.'; Administrator sign-in applies when single sign-on is the main method.
corrections.after: Administrator sign-in appears when staff password sign-in is off (SSO or magic-link primary view). The refusal text is 'Password sign-in is disabled for this account.' (instance.ts assertPasswordSignIn and session.create hook).

corrections.before: Two-factor adds a challenge only to password sign-in; the identity provider controls any challenge during single sign-on.
corrections.after: Voluntary enrollment still challenges password sign-in only. When the organization requires two-factor (requireTwoFactor), /api/v1/me sets twoFactorSetupRequired or twoFactorVerificationRequired and the web redirects to /auth/two-factor/enroll or /auth/two-factor after every sign-in method, including magic links and SSO. The enroll page shows 'Your organization requires two-factor authentication.', asks for Password only when the account has one, and uses 'Turn on two-factor'.

corrections.before: Restart sign-in if the challenge no longer works.
corrections.after: The challenge page now has a Sign out control (two-factor.tsx); the article names it.

corrections.before: Re-enroll replaces the authenticator; Turn off two-factor removes it.
corrections.after: Re-enroll turns off the old authenticator before enrollment, so an abandoned re-enrollment leaves two-factor off. When two-factor is required, Profile shows 'Required by your organization' instead of Re-enroll and Turn off two-factor.

corrections.before: The sign-in page does not offer a password-reset form.
corrections.after: The password view offers 'Set up or reset your password' when email is configured. It asks for Email, sends with 'Send password setup link', answers 'Check your email' neutrally, and the emailed link expires in one hour.

confirmed: Invitation set-password page labels New password, Confirm password, Set password, Password set, Sign in; at least 8 characters; mismatch, expired/used and missing-token messages.
Contributor is no longer invitable (INVITABLE_ROLES) and the article scope is Administrator and Legal Team Member.
'Continue with single sign-on' and 'Single sign-on is not configured yet. Use administrator sign-in.' copy.
'Email me a sign-in link' depends on the group policy and emailConfigured; the link expires in 5 minutes and works once.
Profile enrollment dialog: Turn on two-factor, Password, Continue, QR code with manual secret, Code, Confirm, backup codes shown once, Done.
Challenge page: Two-factor authentication, Code, Verify, Use a backup code, Backup code; 15-minute lockout message after repeated failures.
Sign out in the name menu; Sign out other devices in Profile Sessions ends every other session.
An Administrator landing on Home while onboarding is incomplete goes to /welcome.

articles.classification: behaviour change (reopens review; fresh walkthrough needed)

corrections.before: The entry page says 'Legal portal' and shows Email with Send link.
corrections.after: /portal/enter redirects to /portal/login, titled 'Business Portal sign-in'. Its first view follows the Business Portal policy: SSO, then password, then magic link. On the seeded labs (legacy built-in defaults) the password form shows first, so the reader selects 'Email me a sign-in link' to reach 'Get a sign-in link'.

corrections.before: After the link, the Portal lists that person's Requests.
corrections.after: A Business User without portalOnboardingCompletedAt is redirected to /portal/onboarding ('We need to learn a little about you'). Department is required when Departments exist; later steps offer Skip; the last step offers Finish.

corrections.before: 'Sign-in links are switched off' page with a 'Sign in' control.
corrections.after: That page no longer exists. Without magic links the page offers the other enabled methods: Email and Password with 'Set up or reset your password' (business setup token, one-hour link), or 'Continue with single sign-on'; with no method it shows 'Sign-in is unavailable. Contact your administrator.'
Business Portal Authentication can require two-factor; Business Users are redirected to enrollment (?portal=1) and then challenged each session.

corrections.before: Under 'Primary Document', select 'Read Document' or 'Download'; the page says when no primary Document exists.
corrections.after: The Contract page has a Documents section. 'Primary Document' is a label on the primary row; the Document name opens the reader; a download icon has the name 'Download {name}, version {n}'.

corrections.before: Link text 'Profile settings' for the own-Portal-view section.
corrections.after: Link text 'Personal settings'; the anchor is unchanged.

confirmed: 'Check your email' neutral response: 'If {email} is eligible, a sign-in link is on its way. It expires in 5 minutes and works once.'
Addresses outside allowed domains without a staff account get no link (API still answers 202).
INVALID_TOKEN redirects to /auth/link-expired?portal=1, titled 'Sign-in link expired', with Email and Send link when business magic links are on, else 'Back to sign-in'.
Portal header Sign out returns to /portal/login.
Another person's Request number returns 404 and redirects to /portal.
Portal navigation bar: Requests, Contracts, Matters, Auto-Docs; list titles 'Your Contracts' and 'Your Matters'; 'Show more'.
Portal Contract and Matter lists require current team membership and exclude archived records.
Unverified marker and explanation on the Portal Contract page.
Record pages show Fields, Documents and Original request; applets Comments, History and Contract team or Matter team.
A converted Request redirects to its record (redirectTo).

'Your Tasks' title, 'Load more Tasks', 'No open Tasks assigned to you.', due-date order with undated last.

Columns menu with 'Move {column} earlier/later'; views menu Default view, Modified, Save, Save as…, Rename…, Set as default, Delete…, Discard unsaved changes; delete dialog says records are not touched.
